source_evidence: Exact player 'enter the culvert' directs V/Cirren/Fenar to use the already discovered dry drainage crawlspace despite P6's challenge, not attack, spend a feature, or emerge into open camp regardless of danger. D356~15:12 party moves 25ft from southeast scrub to sheltered exterior mouth near(140,-40), using existing vegetation/ground cover rather than claiming a successful new Stealth check. V leads, Cirren follows, Fenar follows willingly. Passage ~3ft clearance, traversable by ordinary crawling at half movement; approximate70ft path from exterior mouth to interior(70,-40) fixed from prior surveyed endpoints; no invented lock, trap, obstruction or limited resource. Resolve roughly half a minute of movement while enemy reacts to actual failed group Stealth: P6 remains on perch, calls attention to movement outside eastern side; P5 orders P8 to check southern/eastern inner perimeter. P8 leaves stores(70,20), moves along inside to approximately(85,-30), 18ft from inner opening, examining perimeter, not magically aware of culvert intruders or precise identities. P1–P4 in clearing are alert to shout, P5 stays captain area, P7 west gate, P6 perch; no actual signal or additional force. As V nears interior opening he can see daylight and P8 moving/watching nearby from within passage; he stops short of exposing himself, C and F in single file behind. V approx10ft along passage short of interior opening, C5ft behind V, F5ft behind C, party entirely within culvert and no open interior entry yet. Existing prior group Stealth failure remains consequential: camp alert and P8 has relocated, no new successful concealment or surprise guaranteed. Guard has not yet visibly identified them inside culvert; no attack/initiative or contested new stealth roll because party moved within covered path and halted before direct exposure. No additional alarm beyond actual shouted challenge/order, no injury, spell, coin, food or gear use. Fixed camp roster eight and two laborers unchanged; no new report/deployment. V next action at inner mouth before potential detection; may wait, retreat, attempt quiet emergence or engage. All prior facts preserved.
